meta.name: value-prop-lister
meta.description: Extract and organize all value propositions from a company website or materials into a structured inventory, categorized by type and mapped to personas and outreach channels. Use when asked "list my value props", "what value do we provide", "extract our benefits", "summarize our value propositions", "what should I highlight in outreach", "organize our messaging", or "what do we offer customers". Use to inform offer framing, email copy, and sales enablement.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 提取网站价值主张并整理成结构化清单
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从公司材料中提取并组织价值主张用于销售沟通。
copy.tagline_en: Extract and organize value propositions from company materials into a structured list
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to extract and organize value propositions from company materials for sales outreach.

howto.what: 安装此技能后，当你提供公司网站或材料，Claude会提取所有价值主张，按7种类型（如结果、效率、质量等）分类，并映射到目标人物和推广渠道，最终输出结构化的价值主张清单。
howto.when: 当你提出“列出我们的价值主张”、“提取我们的好处”、“总结我们的价值主张”等类似请求时触发。

say.note: Claude会从你提供的材料中提取并分类。
Claude会转换为结果导向的价值主张。
Claude会按等级和渠道优化信息。

howto.what_en: When installed, upon receiving company website or materials, Claude extracts all value propositions, categorizes them into 7 types (e.g., outcome, efficiency, quality), maps to personas and outreach channels, and outputs a structured inventory.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask "list my value props", "what value do we provide", "extract our benefits", "summarize our value propositions", "what should I highlight in outreach", "organize our messaging", or "what do we offer customers".

say_en.note: Claude extracts and categorizes from your materials.
Claude ranks by tier and channel.
